scope: Read-only shared-dialog inventory; concrete findings and proposed allocation only, no product correction

names.validation: Existing validNameSnapshot/validCustomName validate every generated response; safe ASCII names avoid generated-name spelling.

large_integers: Pool/name revision9223372036854775806 and decrementing pool revisions
data_contracts.read_arguments: Exact operation-specific keys; all=true for name/pool inventory, bounded int64 cursors and bounded epoch; other arguments and every other operation refuse.

findings.problem: Resource names form grows beyond the native dialog at desktop and selected doubled-token medium size. Native read/set/clear action text and field content cross the true panel clip, and focusing the actions does not make the whole controls fit.
findings.proposed_boundary: Review a distinct noninteractive Resource names body hook and scoped body/field/action minimum/available-width styles. Preserve native dialog/controls, exact IDs, full values, naming/CAS authority, callbacks and global styling.

findings.problem: Search button opening focuses the native panel; immediate physical typing leaves query empty. The stock shortcut focuses the native query and accepts the same typing in all four cases.
findings.proposed_boundary: Review only the app CommandPalette button/opening focus path, preserving stock shortcut/query/event semantics. Any shared graph/engine change requires separate allocation.

findings.problem: An unchanged successful Read current names resets the unsaved name to the active saved name for the same selected reference and exact revision. Ordinary status refresh retains the draft and original focused field.
findings.proposed_boundary: Review naming-console load/selection dirty-draft handling for the same exact binding/source/context. Keep explicit target-change behavior, expected_revision, writes/unknown-intent protocol and authority intact.

findings.problem: Long valid loaded labels consume each non-command row and collapse native help to zero width at the measured sizes. Exact IDs in keywords remain searchable, but visible item context is lost. Label compaction/ellipsis is existing deliberate behavior and alone is not the finding.
findings.proposed_boundary: Review an app-only palette presentation hook and scoped readable label/help allocation. Preserve native option/query/highlight/arrow/activation and exact entry identities; no global palette theme changes are allocated.

qualifications: This is successful inventory/safety collection with negative geometry and draft/focus findings, not visual acceptance or authorized remediation.

Initial fixture probes assumed an exact Search accessible name without its hint, a nested dialog panel, a unique Close control and a still-visible dialog after native picker Escape; failures are retained. The first report writer also failed serializing raw BigInt arguments after cleanup code and has no durable positive cleanup receipt.

Earlier fixture records lacked published Message deliveries and used placeholder registry state/freshness; final frozen data uses the published shapes/states. Earlier source maps retain their own qualification. Initial native End/Home sequences lacked explicit scroll settling, and the Display refresh comparison incorrectly retained a DOM reference from before a deliberate dialog close/reopen; final checks settle the original scrollers and compare the current opening.

Native select/input painted glyph bounds are unavailable. Full stored values, control boxes/scroll metrics, DOM labels and native keyboard actions are recorded; no native OS popup-glyph reading claim.
Selected pixel text tokens doubled is not universal browser zoom. Native field/button/select fonts can remain fixed and are measured.

Native panel/field focus is deliberate test navigation; no product focus patch or script repositioning is applied. Short tall dialogs require scrolling; initial offscreen footer is distinguished from reachability by native focus/End/Home.

In this headless native Theme picker check, Space/Escape preserves its selected value and closes the containing dialog; no general OS-popup Escape contract is inferred. Display has no data-read operation; its graph/storage-only controls are exercised before/after ordinary refresh and synthetic disconnect.

Search pending-read Escape closes and release does not reopen. Names busy state disables form actions/footer Close while native header Close/Escape remains available; its pending Escape closes and release does not reopen. This is read cancellation UI evidence, not a backend cancellation protocol.

No palette entry was activated and no naming set/clear was submitted. Every mutation, login action, real API/socket/external request and clipboard write is refused. Display choice changes affect only the fresh private graph/storage and are restored.

No real host discovery, contacts, enrollment, auth/remote activity, configuration or resources are used. No broad suite/build/install/source activation. Independent source review/composition and full UX/TUI/live transport remain open.
